test_complete_digital_admission_dossier_.root_cause: Test was written under Session 33 assumption that paying application_fee triggers immediate auto-enrollment. In Session 34 Remediation Issue 2, application fee was decoupled from enrollment, advancing application to 'submitted'. Only admission_fee triggers enrollment. The test fixture was not updated to pay admission_fee.
test_complete_digital_admission_dossier_.operational_verdict: Remediation logic is sound; legacy demo test fixture is obsolete.

test_the_funnel_starts_at_enquiries_and_.root_cause: seed.py lines 2561-2575 added application APP-2026-0099 for Abhinav Saxena with status=ApplicationStatus.enrolled to support hostel/transport day-scholar test fixtures. This violated the test's assumption of a zero enrolled baseline in cycle 1.
test_the_funnel_starts_at_enquiries_and_.operational_verdict: Test assumption valid for clean slate; polluted by static seed additions.

test_a_teacher_can_read_their_class_rost.root_cause: seed.py lines 2505-2545 added 2 extra students (ADM-2024-00101 and ADM-2024-00102) into Class Section 10-A, increasing roll from 10 to 12. Test asserted on hardcoded literal 10.
test_a_teacher_can_read_their_class_rost.operational_verdict: Endpoint functions correctly; test asserted on static literal rather than dynamic count.

test_a_class_of_ten_is_not_reported_as_a.root_cause: Class Section 10-A has 12 students in seed.py. Test asserted on hardcoded 10.
test_a_class_of_ten_is_not_reported_as_a.operational_verdict: Endpoint correctly counts 12 enrolled students; test literal outdated.

test_the_office_still_reads_every_child.root_cause: Total enrolled students in seed.py is 102 (100 demo + 2 day scholars). Test asserted on literal 100.
test_the_office_still_reads_every_child.operational_verdict: Office endpoint correctly returns all 102 children.

test_the_roster_exports_as_csv.root_cause: CSV export exports all 102 students present in database. Test asserted on 100.
test_the_roster_exports_as_csv.operational_verdict: CSV export fully operational and complete; test literal outdated.

test_the_first_year_has_no_retention_fig.root_cause: Total students in demo academic year is 102. Test asserted on 100.
test_the_first_year_has_no_retention_fig.operational_verdict: Enrollment trend calculation accurate; test literal outdated.

test_retention_counts_the_children_who_c.root_cause: 30 retained students divided by 102 previous-year students equals 29.41% (not 30/100 = 30.0%).
test_retention_counts_the_children_who_c.operational_verdict: Math is strictly correct (30 / 102 = 29.4%). Test assumed 100 base.

test_the_dashboard_and_the_report_card_a.root_cause: report_cards.py includes absent papers in total_max denominator (yielding 31.0%), but stats.py exam_percentages() omits absent papers from denominator (yielding 37.2%).
test_the_dashboard_and_the_report_card_a.operational_verdict: CRITICAL CALCULATION DIVERGENCE: Executive analytics conflict with printed report cards.

test_performance_buckets_cover_every_sco.root_cause: stats.py performance buckets aggregate students who have marks in term exams (100 students). It does not include newly admitted or unexamined students (the 2 day scholars). Test assumed total students == total examined students.
test_performance_buckets_cover_every_sco.operational_verdict: Schools enrolling mid-term students will observe divergence between student headcount and performance bucket totals.

academic_year_rollover.enrolment_creation: VERIFIED (Creates new Enrolment, sets old to 'promoted')
academic_year_rollover.fee_concession_migration: NOT IMPLEMENTED (Fee concessions expire with old enrolment_id)
academic_year_rollover.transport_assignment_migration: NOT IMPLEMENTED (Bus stop allocations remain on old enrolment_id)
academic_year_rollover.operational_impact: CRITICAL REAL-WORLD DEFECT: Following year-end session rollover, promoted students cannot be billed correctly in monthly billing runs, lose all sibling/staff concessions, and disappear from bus pickup rosters.

timetable_concurrency.room_index_def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_timetable_room_slot ON public.timetable_slots USING btree (school_id, room, day_of_week, period_id) WHERE ((room IS NOT NULL) AND ((room)::text <> ''::text))
timetable_concurrency.operational_verdict: Teacher and Room collisions are strictly prevented at database transaction layer. Concurrent slot insertions targeting the same teacher or normalized room fail atomically with constraint violation.

certificate_dues_gate.operational_impact: SEVERE FINANCIAL LEAKAGE: Transfer Certificates can be generated and printed for students with outstanding fee balances. Once a TC is delivered to a parent, schools forfeit legal and administrative leverage to collect unpaid dues.

mobile_offline_architecture.operational_impact: MEDIUM RISK: Mobile apps authenticate and store JWT in AsyncStorage, but do not support offline optimistic roll-call caching or queued mutations. If school Wi-Fi drops while teacher marks attendance, the form fails with network error.

backup_and_recovery.operational_impact: HIGH RISK: The ERP codebase contains zero automated database backup or point-in-time recovery scripts. If PostgreSQL storage corrupts or server crashes, the school risks complete data loss unless external unmanaged infrastructure backups exist.

security_and_tenancy.operational_verdict: Multi-tenant isolation enforced cleanly via tenancy.get_owned() and school_id filtering.
